reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) concerns HEA coatings and bulk HEA corrosion in molten salt, not the native oxide behavior of Q235 steel. Neither passage provides data on Fe3O4 self-healing, fluxing, or spallation on Q235, nor does it compare Q235 to a Cr-rich reference under the proposed conditions. The key premises are therefore unsupported by the cited studies.
premises: Native oxide on Q235 is Fe3O4 and is self-healing at room temperature
High-temperature salt causes oxide destabilization, fluxing, and spallation
Thermal expansion mismatch and salt chemistry drive oxide failure
Q235 will show higher mass loss and corrosion than a Cr-rich reference
